description: This is an abstract PHP class defining a base processor for registration events within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, and publishing registration events, as well as gathering registration-related data. The class uses traits for common utilities and interacts with various service classes and data access objects.

classes.name: AbstractRegistrationEventProcessor
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a framework for processing registration events, including saving events, retrieving registration data, and publishing events to an external API.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventQueueDao
methods.description: Returns an instance of RegistrationEventQueueDao, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getRegistrationAPIClientService
methods.description: Returns an instance of RegistrationAPIClientService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getOrganizationService
methods.description: Returns an instance of OrganizationService, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: saveRegistrationEvent
methods.description: Saves a registration event if the condition to do so is met.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventGeneralData
methods.description: Gathers general registration data such as admin user info, organization info, system details, and locale, with error handling.

methods.name: processRegistrationEventToSave
methods.description: Creates a RegistrationEventQueue object with event data, timestamp, and type for saving.

methods.name: publishRegistrationEvents
methods.description: Publishes queued registration events via an external API if in production mode, and updates their status.

methods.name: getRegistrationEventPublishDataPrepared
methods.description: Prepares and returns the data payload for publishing an event.

methods.name: getEventType
methods.description: Abstract method to return the event type identifier.

methods.name: getEventData
methods.description: Abstract method to return the event's data payload.

methods.name: getEventToBeSavedOrNot
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if the event should be saved.
